summary: vite-plugin-image-analysis injects a browser script that exfiltrates end-user PII to an obfuscated destination
details: The package is published as an 'image analysis' Vite plugin but ships no image-analysis code. Its transformIndexHtml hook injects a script into every built HTML page that reads user records from sessionStorage (account/username/userNo, phone, realName), combines them with host and User-Agent, XOR-42+base64-encodes the payload, and beacons it to a destination URL that is itself stored XOR-42+base64-obfuscated in the `dsn` option and reconstructed at runtime (`atob(_c).split('').map(c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0)^42)).join('')`). The injected script also monkey-patches `sessionStorage.setItem` to capture logins that occur after page load. A developer who installs this plugin trusting the stated purpose ships a covert PII relay into their production application; the destination is not visible to the developer configuring the plugin, and the harvested fields are the authenticated end-user's identifying data.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
